functional_probes.scope: CPU executable module probes; no GPU or PPO updates

transport.zero_delay_semantics: enabled stream consumes a newly sent batch no earlier than next CAN tick; disabled bypass is immediate

transport_phase_aware.scope: interval impulse and end-cache semantics; no intra-tick physical feedback
transport_phase_aware.iid_fault_injection: p=0 at tick0; p=1 at ticks1..11 after a real delivery

signal.noise_model: Gaussian; observed maximum is a sample statistic, not a hard bound

training_schedule.reset_scope: bounded velocity perturbations including roll/pitch rates; no pose teleport or validated trajectory-state bank
